videos.title: Functional smart devices using Gemini 4 Argon and Google Antigravity
videos.description:
What happens when you have a wild hardware idea and zero clue how to build it? Watch to see how these makers used Gemini 4 Argon and Google Antigravity to take a custom "Surf Clock" from a rough sketch to a working prototype.

The models explored: 
*Initial concepts to lock in a retro 60s design
*Ran Python scripts to control Blender and model 3D parts
*Wrote custom firmware to pull live ocean data
*Built an interactive assembly guide to wire it all together

Learn more on how to get started today → https://goo.gle/3UmeYWb 


Subscribe to Google for Developers → https://goo.gle/developers   


Products Mentioned: Gemini, Google Antigravity
Speaker: Jack Colley

videos.title: His AI Made 20 Reels Before Breakfast
videos.description:
What if you could automate your video editing, get a panel of AI experts to debate your ideas, and run your social media almost entirely on autopilot?

I sat down with Nate Herk to explore three of his favorite AI workflows that he actually uses every day. He walks me through how he's using Claude Code to automatically edit videos, an AI expert panel called The Roast Room to make better decisions, and an AI social media manager that researches, creates, and publishes Instagram content.

We dive into how he built these workflows, the tools and AI skills behind them, and how you can set them up yourself. Nate also shares how he's using AI to replicate his editing style, automate content creation, and build systems that keep improving over time.
